commands.command: pnpm exec vitest run src/features/surfaces/SurfaceCatalog.test.tsx -t "keeps the catalog usable without browser storage or providers"
commands.assertions: With no providers and denied browser storage, Portal renders its text/capability UI, reports an empty catalog, and keeps the selection control accessible.

assertions: Provider absence produces an explicit empty state rather than a crash.
Storage denial does not disable ordinary Portal browsing or chatting.
No provider error details are exposed to the user.
limitations: Other optional provider lifecycle and route-equivalence cases remain open.
